formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list used as normalized; normalized one-based positions.
formulaBlock.e3ProminenceCutoff: No Parfum declared -> preservative fallback: Sodium Benzoate at 15 -> positions 1-14 prominent

cleansingStrength.rationale: C4/C5: the earliest prominent strong anionic is Sodium Coco-Sulfate (4, alkyl sulfate) -> defining anionic; buffers Coco-Glucoside (2) and Sodium Cocoamphoacetate (5) (two buffers), no reinforcing route -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: The glucoside is listed before the sulfate and Glycerin (3) sits before it too: a glucoside-led, buffered architecture argues toward low; the convention keeps moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful cationic system, Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (12), plus light routes: weak refatters Glyceryl Oleate (11), Hydrogenated Palm Glycerides Citrate (13), Lecithin (14), and humectants Glycerin (3), Panthenol (7). C2 not met (no silicone, no payload lipid).
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: No silicone or payload lipid; the refatters are weak.

weightPotential.rationale: One cationic guar plus weak refatters; no silicone, payload lipid, protein or film former.

depositionLoad.rationale: Guar (12) and weak refatters (11, 13, 14) with Tocopherol/Ascorbyl Palmitate (9, 10).

persistence.rationale: No persistent silicone or lipid system.

resetCapacity.rationale: Coco-sulfate with glucoside and amphoacetate (C5 moderate); a mild-leaning but complete chassis.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: Deposition is light and weakly retained.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: two families, but the only families are a single guar and weak_refatters (plus humectants); no silicone/lipid/film former, so combined residue is plausibly below noticeable.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar at 12 is fairly prominent in a short list; one step toward moderate is realistic.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: mild, fragrance-free, comfort/humectant-rich (Glycerin, Panthenol, Niacinamide) -> plausible scalp_active (sensitive) or moisture candidate; no claims seen.
focusPrimary.careDirectionVerdictProvisional: moisture_supported (humectant cluster with guar/refatter support; modest)

usageRole.rationale: Default; frequent possible with explicit frequency wording (cleansing not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met: prominent comfort routes Panthenol (7), Niacinamide (8); humectant routes Glycerin (3), Glyceryl Oleate (11). Supportive: no declared fragrance.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole in the complete INCI.
